i.norm: Verifies that after advancing forward with nextToken(), previousToken() correctly returns the tokenizer to the previous position and retrieves the single CSV token. The input "%*dR|" contains no commas, so the CSV tokenizer treats the entire string as one token. After nextToken() consumes it, nextIndex() reflects the cursor has moved past position 0. Calling previousToken() moves the cursor back and returns the token that was just passed.
A single-token CSV string (no commas, so the whole value is one token)
Advance past the first (and only) token
Cursor is now at index 1, meaning one token has been consumed
Navigate backwards: previousToken() moves the cursor back and returns the token
